description: This Java class represents a data transfer object for the SMS message API report resource, encapsulating request data for/reporting SMS message status or information via an API endpoint.

classes.name: SmsMessageApiReportResourceData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing the API request body sent in the POST request to the '/report' resource, with fields for external IDs and tenant identifier, and methods for instance creation and JSON serialization.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new instance of SmsMessageApiReportResourceData with provided external IDs and tenant identifier.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes the instance to its JSON string representation using Gson.
